summary: Verified file integrity: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx is 196 lines and ends cleanly at '});' — orphaned trailing lines are gone (confirmed by wc/tail). Lint is clean. HOWEVER, E2E testing exposes a CRITICAL runtime bug: the Chat screen still crashes with a red-screen 'ReferenceError: model is not defined' at app/chat/[id].tsx:99:29. The component references `model` and `setModel` on lines 46 and 99 but never declares them via useState (scan.tsx does declare this state on line 29). As a consequence the Chat screen does NOT mount, no chat-back/chat-model-picker/chat-input/chat-send testIDs render, header 'INSIDE OUT ENGINEER' is not visible, and the SSE round-trip cannot be tested. Fix scope: add `const [model, setModel] = useState<string>(user?.preferred_model || 'claude-sonnet-4-6');` and destructure `user` from `useAuth()`.

Also `useAuth()` is not destructuring `user` (line 18: `const { token } = useAuth();`) — need `user` to seed `preferred_model` default like scan.tsx does. Chat screen fails to mount for any project.

rca_of_issue: RCA: The ONLY change described in the problem statement was removing orphaned trailing bytes after the StyleSheet closing '});' (a cosmetic/syntactic cleanup that made the bundle parseable). That fix is verified good. However, the file still references `model` and `setModel` (lines 46 and 99) as if a `useState<string>(...)` line existed — likely deleted or never added when the ModelPicker was wired into Chat. At runtime React throws 'ReferenceError: model is not defined' the moment the Chat component tries to render <ModelPicker value={model} .../>. Reproduction: sign in with test@insideout.app / testpass123 → open https://build-inside-1.preview.emergentagent.com/chat/5d1e9372-988b-46c0-a3ce-360333128e74 → red-screen 'Uncaught Error: model is not defined' appears immediately (app/chat/[id].tsx:99:29). Mitigation: add `const [model, setModel] = useState<string>(user?.preferred_model || 'claude-sonnet-4-6');` and destructure `user` from useAuth() (mirror scan.tsx:29).
